# Reference: profile.toml

<!-- Generated by docs/gen_reference.py from profilekit/schema.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Everything the kit renders comes from this file. Only [profile].handle and [profile].name are required; every other table is optional and switches its section on.

Length limits are layout limits: a longer text would not fit its graphic. Validate any file with `python3 -m profilekit validate`; see the [CLI reference](reference-cli.md). For worked examples, read [how to design your skyline](howto-design-your-skyline.md) and [`profilekit/example.toml`](../profilekit/example.toml).

Contents: [`profile`](#profile) · [`hub`](#hub) · [`links`](#links) · [`status`](#status) · [`focus`](#focus) · [`org`](#org) · [`terminal`](#terminal) · [`recommend`](#recommend) · [`contributions`](#contributions) · [`city`](#city) · [`lightup`](#lightup) · [`sections`](#sections)

## profile

TOML: `[profile]`

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Limits | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `handle` | string | yes |  | pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,38})$` | GitHub login. Used for live stats and image URLs. |
| `name` | string | yes |  | max 28 chars | Display name in the header. |
| `kicker` | string |  |  | max 60 chars | Small caps line above the name, e.g. 'FOUNDER & CTO · ACME'. |
| `build_prefix` | string |  | `"I build"` | max 14 chars | Lead-in before the rotating words. |
| `words` | list of strings |  |  | max 6 items; min 1 item; each max 24 chars | Rotating words after the lead-in. End each with a period for the typed look. |
| `theme` | one of `"ink"`, `"slate"` |  | `"ink"` |  | Colour theme: ink (neutral greys, violet accent) or slate (cool blue-greys, teal accent). |
| `accent` | string |  |  | pattern `^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$` | Optional accent colour (hex) that re-tints the theme. |
| `repo` | string |  |  | pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9-]+/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$` | owner/name of the profile repository. Defaults to handle/handle. |
| `credit` | boolean |  | `true` |  | Small 'Built with github-profile-kit' line at the bottom. |

## hub

TOML: `[hub]`

Animated network graphic on the right of the header: inputs flow into a hub, outputs flow out.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Limits | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `center` | string |  |  | max 5 chars | Text inside the hub circle, e.g. your company initials. |
| `label` | string |  |  | max 14 chars | Small caps label under the hub. |
| `inputs` | list of strings |  |  | max 4 items; each max 6 chars | Up to four nodes on the left that flow into the hub (blue packets). |
| `outputs` | list of strings |  |  | max 3 items; each max 9 chars | Up to three nodes on the right that the hub feeds (green packets). |
| `ticker` | list of strings |  |  | max 6 items; each max 16 chars | Short values cycling under the hub, e.g. 'p95 12ms'. |

## links

TOML: `[[links]]` (repeat the table for each entry)

Buttons in the contact row.

List limits: max 4 items.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Limits | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string | yes |  | max 22 chars | Button text. |
| `url` | string | yes |  | pattern `^https://` | Link target; https only. |
| `icon` | one of `"web"`, `"linkedin"`, `"github"`, `"x"`, `"mastodon"`, `"bluesky"`, `"mail"`, `"rss"` |  | `"web"` |  | Icon drawn left of the label. |

## status

TOML: `[status]`

Pills next to the buttons.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Limits | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `based_in` | string |  |  | max 28 chars | Shown as 'BASED IN <value>'. |
| `open_to` | string |  |  | max 44 chars | Shown as 'OPEN TO <value>', e.g. 'collaborations · talent'. |

## focus

TOML: `[[focus]]` (repeat the table for each entry)

Up to four cards with an animated visual each.

List limits: max 4 items.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Limits | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | yes |  | max 22 chars | Card title. |
| `line1` | string |  |  | max 32 chars | First line under the title. |
| `line2` | string |  |  | max 32 chars | Second line under the title. |
| `tags` | list of strings |  |  | max 3 items; each max 10 chars | Small chips at the bottom of the card. |
| `visual` | one of `"auction"`, `"retail"`, `"sync"`, `"ledger"` |  |  |  | auction = bidders racing, retail = shelf to screen to receipt, sync = phones in lockstep, ledger = scrolling ledger with sparkline. |

## org

TOML: `[org]`

A wide card linking to a company or organisation.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Limits | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kicker` | string |  | `"BUILDING"` | max 20 chars | Small caps line above the name. |
| `name` | string | yes |  | max 32 chars | Organisation name. |
| `tagline` | string |  |  | max 60 chars | One line under the name. |

## terminal

TOML: `[terminal]`

A typed terminal session: whoami, --help flags, live processes, principles.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Limits | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | string |  |  | max 30 chars | Window title, e.g. 'ada@engine'. |
| `command` | string |  |  | pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,15}$` | Command name used for '<command> --help'. |
| `whoami` | string |  |  | max 48 chars | Output of 'whoami'. |
| `whoami_note` | string |  |  | max 40 chars | Muted text after the whoami line, e.g. 'shipping since 2012'. |
| `flags` | list of tables |  |  | max 6 items | Rows of '<command> --help'. Each flag describes one of your roles. |
| `processes` | list of strings |  |  | max 6 items; each max 16 chars | Shown in 'top' with live load bars. |
| `principles` | list of strings |  |  | max 5 items; each max 60 chars | Output of 'cat ./principles'. The first one is highlighted. |

### terminal.flags

TOML: `[[terminal.flags]]`

Rows of '<command> --help'. Each flag describes one of your roles.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Limits | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `flag` | string | yes |  | pattern `^--[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,9}$` | The flag, e.g. '--build'. |
| `text` | string | yes |  | max 52 chars | What the flag stands for. |

## recommend

TOML: `[[recommend]]` (repeat the table for each entry)

Open-source projects you recommend. Language and stars are fetched live.

List limits: max 10 items.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Limits | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `repo` | string | yes |  | pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9-]+/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$` | owner/name on GitHub. |
| `tag` | string |  |  | max 14 chars | Small chip in the top right, e.g. 'CLI'. |
| `line1` | string |  |  | max 48 chars | First description line. Falls back to the repository description. |
| `line2` | string |  |  | max 48 chars | Second description line. |

## city

TOML: `[city]`

The living skyline: time of day and weather come live from Open-Meteo for lat/lon.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Limits | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | max 24 chars | City name, printed top left and used as the seed of the procedural skyline. |
| `lat` | number | yes |  | -90 to 90 | Latitude for weather and sunrise/sunset. |
| `lon` | number | yes |  | -180 to 180 | Longitude for weather and sunrise/sunset. |
| `timezone` | string |  | `"UTC"` |  | IANA name, e.g. Europe/Berlin. |
| `heading` | string |  |  | max 60 chars | Heading above the skyline. |
| `preset` | one of `"generic"` |  | `"generic"` |  | generic = procedural city, seeded by the city name, with the landmarks below. Hand-drawn city presets can be added in profilekit/skyline.py. |
| `sign` | string |  |  | max 3 chars | Up to 3 letters on a glowing rooftop sign. |
| `landmarks` | list of `"tower"`, `"bridge"`, `"spire"`, `"wheel"`, `"dome"` |  |  | no duplicates | Landmarks placed into the procedural city: tower (TV tower, the light-up target), bridge (cable-stayed, right side), spire, wheel (rotating ferris wheel), dome. |
| `river` | boolean |  | `true` |  | Draw a river with waves; false draws plain ground. |
| `creatures` | list of `"boats"`, `"crocodile"`, `"duck"` |  |  | no duplicates | Things swimming in the river. |
| `flag` | table |  |  |  | A small waving flag on a rooftop. |
| `seasons` | list of `"newyear"`, `"advent"`, `"christmas"`, `"karneval"`, `"hoppeditz"` |  |  | no duplicates | Seasonal decorations that switch on automatically. |

### city.flag

TOML: `city.flag = { ... }`

A small waving flag on a rooftop.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Limits | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes |  | max 4 chars | Up to 4 characters on the flag. |
| `color` | string |  |  | pattern `^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$` | Flag colour (hex). Defaults to red. |

## lightup

TOML: `[lightup]`

Visitors open an issue 'light: <colour>' and the tower (or sign) lights up in that colour with their handle.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Limits | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean |  | `true` |  | Turn the light-up game on or off. |
| `title` | string |  | `"Light up the tower"` | max 40 chars | Bold line above the colour links. |

## sections

TOML: `top level`

Order of the README sections. Omit to use the default order; a section without data is skipped.

| Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|
| list of `"header"`, `"contact"`, `"focus"`, `"org"`, `"terminal"`, `"recommend"`, `"contributions"`, `"city"`, `"lightup"` | `["header", "contact", "focus", "org", "terminal", "recommend", "contributions", "city", "lightup"]` | no duplicates |
